A number of '''electrified laser blades''' were used in [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval's]] [[Box/Legends|Box]], as part of the second challenge for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. [[Onca/Legends|Onca]] and [[Kiera Swan/Legends|Kiera Swan]] both lost their lives due to one of the beams.
